label: AU-privacy-act-1988 Section 6EA

obligations.text: (3)	If the Commissioner is satisfied that a small business operator has made the choice to be treated as an organisation, the Commissioner must enter in a register of operators who have made such a choice:
(4)	If a small business operator revokes a choice to be treated as an organisation, the Commissioner must remove from the register the material relating to the operator.
(6)	The Commissioner must make the register available to the public in the way that the Commissioner determines.
However, the Commissioner must not make available to the public in the register information other than that described in subsection (3).
